title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode6 Racing Hearts

meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_wonder_op3
Music Hall

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “No, he's miles and miles away in a different country. He'll never hear me if I keep singing like a squeaky songbird...”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “After giving me so much courage too...”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “He told me that he liked the way I sing, so I have to make sure my voice reaches him!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wow... Her voice is so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This is her first time playing the lead, right? She looks so poised...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My voice wavered there a little...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The audience seems to be reacting okay, but I can't be happy with just this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to do a better job of moving their hearts...!)
After the show

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Nice work with the last show, everyone.
Overall, each performance went really well, and the audience seemed to enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: This is the result of all the hard work you put in day in and day out. Let's keep doing our best and make our next show just as good!

rows.Speaker: Troupe Members
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Each performance went really well, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's good to hear. I'm glad we were able to get through them all...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Amemiya, hello...

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line:
Nice work out there.
I wanted to congratulate our star as the director of this troupe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for going out of your way to do this.

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: You just seem to keep finding ways to get better, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: When you first joined us, you were pretty rough around the edges. But now, you're regularly competing for leading roles.

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: Naturally, you still have a lot of growth potential... But I have to say, Kazamatsuri brought us a real gem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I plan on doing even more moving forward in order to win those roles.

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to seeing how you grow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't be happy with just having a lot of growth potential...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, I've auditioned for countless roles... And just finally managed to become the lead for one show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I have to keep getting better and better.
Or else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I won't be able to go overseas like those two...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member A
rows.Line:
Mr. Amemiya! Kusanagi!
We want to throw an after-party! Are you two free to join us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An after-party?

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member A
rows.Line: Yes, we wanted to give ourselves a big pat on the back! So, we're looking for people who are free to go.

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line:
Ah, that sounds fun. I think I'll go.
What about you, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really appreciate the invitation, but I think I'll pass. Please go on without me.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member B
rows.Line: Wait, Kusanagi, are you gonna head back and practice the way you always do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am. I start getting antsy if I don't since it's basically a part of my routine at this point.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, our next show is just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member B
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Yuka Kazamatsuri agreed to appear as a guest star, right?!

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member C
rows.Line: I know that she and Mr. Amemiya used to be in the same troupe, but I still can't believe she's coming back to Japan to perform in this show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me neither...
I'm excited since she's my hero.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member B
rows.Line: Right. But you just finished doing a show, so don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'll be careful.
Anyway, nice work, everyone.
A few hours later
Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Please put down your sword. I'd rather not see you all covered in blood.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And I'm sure your late mother wouldn't have wanted to see you in this state.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That didn't feel right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Natalie should know exactly why her childhood friend made the decision to go into battle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means she wouldn't just be trying to stop her at all costs. She should be feeling pretty conflicted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, maybe I can try making my voice waver...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Please put down your sword... I'd rather not see you all covered in blood.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And I'm sure your late mother wouldn't have wanted to see you in this state.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
Let's take a look at that video I just took of myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My voice sounds more like how I thought it should, but the way I'm moving still looks kinda funny...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's torn between wanting to respect her friend's wishes and hoping to stop her from going. In order to clearly express that internal conflict...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That really startled me...
I totally forgot to turn off notifications.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu sent me a message...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, she said she wanted to throw a farewell party for Rui and Tsukasa. I wonder where we're doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
We're doing it there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess it is the perfect place for us to gather.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wherever they are right now, they're all doing their best.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which means I also need to keep practicing.)
<I want you to be the one to figure out what's truly best for you.>
<And I'll do whatever I can to help you find that answer.>
<It won't be easy, but doing your best by working together as a team to get through this will do wonders for you in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Who said that just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, it's been so long...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? M-Ms. Kazamatsuri?!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
I got back to Japan a little while ago.
Amemiya let me know his troupe would be throwing an after-party today and invited me to join. He wanted to introduce me to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That's where I heard that you were probably still practicing, Nene. So, I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's so nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm really looking forward to performing in that show with you!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm also looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Have you been taking breaks, Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, yes...
I've been taking quick breathers here and there while checking over the videos I've been taking of myself...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Amemiya was right. You really do have an incredible work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But you need to take proper breaks. To be perfectly honest, you look pretty tired.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I do? I'll be careful...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Anyway, now that I've had a chance to see you, Nene, I'm going to head back. I'd rather not be in your way for too long.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But promise to take real breaks, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Then, I'll see you later.
And don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I promise to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ms. Kazamatsuri's such a nice person.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She came all this way just to see me, and she expressed genuine concern...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to do my best...
